article_title: Alberta's decision to stay in Canada gives Carney backing to take on Trump

tasks.prompt: What is the article's main argument about Alberta's referendum result?
options: The decisive vote to remain in Canada strengthens national unity and supports Carney's economic and political response to US pressure.
The vote immediately ended every provincial disagreement in Canada.
Alberta chose to become the 51st US state.
The result forced Canada to abandon plans for new trade alliances.
tasks.correct_answer: The decisive vote to remain in Canada strengthens national unity and supports Carney's economic and political response to US pressure.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה טוענת שההצבעה המכריעה בעד הישארות בקנדה מחזקת את האחדות ואת יכולתו של קרני להתמודד עם לחץ אמריקאי ולקדם גיוון כלכלי.

tasks.prompt: What did preliminary results show about Alberta voters?
options: Exactly half supported separation.
More than two-thirds voted to remain in Canada.
Most wanted Alberta to join the United States.
Fewer than one-third took part in the referendum.
tasks.correct_answer: More than two-thirds voted to remain in Canada.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: לפי התוצאות המקדמיות, יותר משני שלישים מהמצביעים באלברטה רצו שהמחוז יישאר חלק מקנדה.

tasks.prompt: What does “pivotal” mean when Alberta is described as playing a pivotal role?
options: Temporary and largely symbolic
Hidden from public attention
Crucially important to the outcome
Opposed to all federal projects
tasks.explanation_hebrew: pivotal פירושו מרכזי או מכריע; משאבי האנרגיה והמינרלים של אלברטה חשובים מאוד לאסטרטגיה הכלכלית של קנדה.

tasks.prompt: Why does Carney support a proposed pipeline to Canada's Pacific coast?
options: To send all Alberta oil exclusively to the United States
To replace Canada's national railway
To prevent Alberta from trading with Asia
To open Asian markets for Alberta oil and reduce dependence on the United States
tasks.correct_answer: To open Asian markets for Alberta oil and reduce dependence on the United States
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הצינור המוצע אמור לאפשר לנפט מאלברטה להגיע לשווקים באסיה ולצמצם את התלות המסחרית בארה״ב.

tasks.prompt: Why did references to Trump and the United States help the pro-Canada campaign?
options: External threats encouraged voters to rally around Canadian identity and unity.
Trump formally endorsed Alberta's independence campaign.
The United States promised to cancel all tariffs after separation.
Canadian voters believed the referendum was a US midterm election.
tasks.correct_answer: External threats encouraged voters to rally around Canadian identity and unity.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: איומי טראמפ לספח את קנדה והלחץ ממלחמת הסחר חיזקו תחושת פטריוטיות והפכו את האחדות הקנדית לתשובה לאיום חיצוני.

tasks.prompt: What does “eclipse” mean in the statement that political and economic pressures eclipse Carney's green credentials?
options: Prove that his environmental record is false
Create a literal shadow over Alberta
Become more prominent and overshadow his environmental priorities
Guarantee that every project will be carbon neutral
tasks.correct_answer: Become more prominent and overshadow his environmental priorities
tasks.explanation_hebrew: eclipse משמעו להאפיל: שיקולים פוליטיים וכלכליים נעשו בולטים יותר ומסתירים או דוחקים את הרקע הסביבתי של קרני.

tasks.prompt: Identify three ways Alberta matters to Canada's economic strategy.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שלושה פרטים מדויקים על משאבים, סחר, תשתיות, אנרגיה או גיוון שווקים.
expected_points: Alberta contains most of Canada's proven oil reserves.
It has abundant gas and mineral wealth.
Its resources are central to plans to diversify trade during the US trade war.
A Pacific pipeline could connect Alberta oil to Asian markets.
Carney presents Alberta as the core of a potential global energy superpower.

tasks.prompt: Summarise how the referendum result affects Carney at home and abroad.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להתייחס לאחדות, לפרויקטים הכלכליים, ליחסים עם ארה״ב ולמגבלות או לשאלות הפתוחות לאחר ההצבעה.
expected_points: The decisive remain vote gives Carney political support for his message of Canadian unity.
It strengthens his case for infrastructure and energy projects designed to reduce US dependence.
It supports his firm response to Trump, including retaliatory tariffs and broader foreign partnerships.
Other referendum questions and provincial grievances still create domestic debate.
Canada remains economically vulnerable because the United States traditionally receives about 70% of its exports.

tasks.prompt: Why does David Moscrop question whether Canadian unity will remain as strong after Trump leaves office?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר שהאיום החיצוני המשותף מאחד קבוצות שונות, אך מחלוקות פנימיות על סמכויות, הגירה, רגולציה וחלוקת משאבים עשויות לשוב למרכז הבמה.
expected_points: Trump provides a single, visible external target around which Canadians can rally.
Without that target, provincial grievances may again become more prominent.
Unresolved issues include provincial powers, immigration costs, constitutional change and federal environmental rules.
The current unity may therefore depend partly on a temporary external pressure.

tasks.prompt: Write a short political analysis using the words “referendum”, “diversifying” and “retaliatory”.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להשתמש בשלוש המילים במדויק, לקשור בין תוצאת ההצבעה לאסטרטגיית הסחר ולתגובה הקנדית לארה״ב, ולהציג ניתוח ולא סיסמה.
expected_points: Use all three required words accurately.
State that the referendum produced a decisive vote to remain in Canada.
Explain that Canada is diversifying trade and seeking new alliances or Asian energy markets.
Refer to Carney's retaliatory tariffs or other firm responses to US pressure.
